@andyfeller, `gh auth switch` switches users on a particular host, it has no bearing on what host your commands will target. If you were to log out of both your `github.com` accounts (or use `GH_HOST` as you noticed already) this would work as expected I think.

issue_context.title: Show host name in repo creation prompts
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

I'm logged into multiple accounts across multiple hosts. When I want to create a repo, I want to make sure that I'm doing it in the right place. Right now, the `gh repo create` prompts all refer to performing the task "on GitHub". This isn't necessarily _wrong_, but it doesn't tell me which one.

### Proposed solution

I'd like to propose that we replace "on GitHub" to "on <host>" to be clear as to where the action is being performed.
